notes.title: Greenfeet Haven Playtest #2
notes.content:
The second playtest for Greenfeet Haven is now live!

After a two month of hardwork I'm happy to deliver it to you. It features a number of requested features by the playtesters and more content to discover.

Here's a list of what changed since the first playtest:

[list]
[*] New discoveries to unlock.
[*] New mission system that acts as a tutorial.
[*] New greenfeet will join the village over time.
[*] New zone system to automate and organize your village.
[*] Reworked UI to provide a better experience.
[/list]

Please let me know what you think about this new version! And thank you for helping me make Greenfeet Haven a better game!
